atoms.asks: Using Drucker's five questions or Collins' Hedgehog triad, what is this brand's business, customer, and economic engine (sticky notes, ten words or less)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Drucker or Hedgehog sticky notes covering business, customer, and engine, or unknown.

atoms.asks: On a 2-axis perceptual map of category competitors, where is the marketing or visual white space this brand can own?
atoms.accepts_summary: Axes, competitor sticky notes, and named white space, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Complete Neumeier's Onliness statement: Our brand is the ONLY [Category] that [Point of Difference] for [Target Customer] in [Geographic Market] during [Macro/Cultural Trend].
atoms.accepts_summary: Filled Onliness formula with agreement, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Synthesize the 1-page Brand Brief: purpose, audience, value proposition, five attributes, Onliness, essence, top competitors, and proof points.
atoms.accepts_summary: Brand Brief fields filled or labeled unknown; sticky notes ten words or less where visual.

atoms.asks: Review the Brand Brief. Pass the brand-strategist gate, reopen a section, or record blocking unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass with 'pass brand-strategist gate', reopen, or blocking unknowns.

atoms.asks: Which mark topology fits this brand architecture: Wordmark, Letterform, Pictorial, Abstract, Emblem, or Dynamic?
atoms.accepts_summary: One topology choice with brief why, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Does the mark pass the 1-color black silhouette test at favicon and billboard scale with clear counterforms?
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass/fail on silhouette plus scale notes, or unknown. Do not proceed to color until Shape passes.

atoms.asks: What are Primary, Secondary, and Accent colors with specs, and do they clear competitive sameness plus WCAG contrast?
atoms.accepts_summary: Color roles with PANTONE/CMYK/RGB/HEX where known, differentiation and contrast notes, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Name display, headline, body, and mono faces, then where will you trial the system (most visible and most challenging applications)?
atoms.accepts_summary: Type hierarchy plus two trial applications, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Review the identity system. Pass the identity-system-designer gate, reopen a step, or record blocking unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass with 'pass identity-system-designer gate', reopen, or blocking unknowns.

atoms.asks: Which STEPPS levers drive this brand's content plan: Social Currency, Triggers, Emotion, Public, Practical Value, Stories?
atoms.accepts_summary: Chosen STEPPS levers with one sticky note each (ten words or less), or unknown.

atoms.asks: What is the primary digital touchpoint (site or app), and what first real user task will you usability-test without rescuing?
atoms.accepts_summary: Named primary digital surface plus one unrescued test task, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Which physical touchpoint comes first — collateral, packaging shelf, stationery, or branded environment/wayfinding — and what one rule unifies it?
atoms.accepts_summary: Primary physical channel plus one unifying rule sticky note, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Review the touchpoint plan. Pass the touchpoint-architect gate, reopen a channel, or record blocking unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass with 'pass touchpoint-architect gate', reopen, or blocking unknowns.

atoms.asks: Will brand governance run as Cop (static PDF policing) or Concierge (Online Brand Center enablement), and what shifts first?
atoms.accepts_summary: Cop vs Concierge choice plus first enablement move, or unknown.

atoms.asks: How will you launch internally first — ambassador kits, culture book, or eLearning — before any external rollout?
atoms.accepts_summary: Internal-first vehicle and sequence, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Which Online Brand Center sections ship first among Strategy & Story, Core Identity, Color & Typography, Asset Libraries, Application Templates, and Support & Approvals?
atoms.accepts_summary: Ordered BEAM/DAM section priorities, or unknown.

atoms.asks: From Prophet's triad, pick one Perception, one Performance, and one Financial metric for the brand scorecard.
atoms.accepts_summary: Three named metrics across mindshare, marketplace, and balance sheet, or unknown.

atoms.asks: Review brand governance. Pass the brand-governance-coach gate, reopen a section, or record blocking unknowns.
atoms.accepts_summary: Pass with 'pass brand-governance-coach gate', reopen, or blocking unknowns.
